name: Hani's Blog
mission: Writing worth rereading on machine learning, product and leadership, in English and Arabic, with interactive demos that let the reader test the idea
measure: published bilingual posts that pass the site's checks (typecheck, lint, build, Playwright) and the editor's review

lines.title: Starting budget
lines.approvedBy: the author, 2026-10-25 ("decide for me"; Meta decided $100)

intake.name: Hani's Blog
intake.purpose: Writing worth rereading on machine learning, product and leadership, in English and Arabic, with interactive demos that let the reader test the idea
intake.product: bilingual posts (EN/AR), the book The Dream, interactive demos, content sparks
intake.measure: published bilingual posts that pass the site's checks (typecheck, lint, build, Playwright) and the editor's review

design: system3-meta docs/proposals/2026-10-25-blog-org.md (design 1: an editorial desk around the author)

newRoles.title: Editor (argument, then sentences)
newRoles.mission: One warm session per post: the argument, then the sentences in the author's voice, both as proposals (replaces the developmental and line editors, 2026-10-25, PRINCIPLES.md P2).

newRoles.title: Arabic editor
newRoles.mission: The Arabic edition: mature conversational Levantine in the author's voice (translate-post), parity with the English, translationOf links.

newRoles.title: Demo designer
newRoles.mission: What a demo must teach: learning test cases first (edu-demo-test-cases, the decision-lab pedagogy).

newRoles.title: Demo builder
newRoles.mission: Self-contained demo bundles that pass their test cases (edu-demo-builder).

newRoles.title: Demo evaluator
newRoles.mission: Judges demos in the browser on their test cases, artifact before account (edu-demo-evaluator); never judges its own work.

newRoles.title: Snippets editor
newRoles.mission: Snippets from published posts, in both languages, released in batches the author approves.

baseline: design 2, one writing assistant, was weighed at onboarding (docs/proposals/2026-10-25-blog-org.md in system3-meta); the record of 6 September (edits that went too far, an unsupported claim) is why the checks are independent
sizeReason: five kinds of work (posts, demos, snippets, site features, localization), each with one maker and its own independent check; roles run only when their flow runs, so at most 4 work at once

flows.reason: the press's writer is the maker; here only publishing

owns.note: the web edition, built from a release S3 Press tags; the manuscripts are S3 Press's

referee.heldOut: each demo's held-out test cases: the demo designer keeps one or two from the builder until the evaluator runs them

stopRule: work over 2× its cost target pauses for the author (PRINCIPLES.md P8)
parkRule: a role with no work in 4 weeks is parked, and comes back when its flow next runs
